renderer: Native WebGL 1; no third-party runtime libraries or paid services
units: Consistent units apply to the optional original 3D renderer. Photographic scenes use fixed source images with scroll-driven crops and dissolves.

geometry.warehouse: Procedural cutaway warehouse, shelves, packing arm and conveyor
geometry.parcel: One persistent hollow box and hinged lid, using the existing parcel texture
geometry.aircraft: Profiled navy fuselage, curved cargo hatch, cockpit glazing, panel seams, engine fans, chrome intake rings and retractable landing gear
geometry.ocean: One continuous ocean surface between physical coastlines, with scroll-dependent water and clouds
geometry.customs: Handling trolley, scanner, sorting belt and loading platform
geometry.truck: Rounded navy cab, corrugated cargo panels, chrome grille, mirrors, lights, hinged doors and rounded rotating tyres
geometry.home: Textured plaster, timber door, reflective glazing, stone paving, planted foliage and doorstep
geometry.courier: Articulated courier with fabric uniform, facial and hand detail; original distance-driven walking, parcel pickup, placement and departure

settings.durations_status: Illustrative and editable; not verified delivery promises

asset_policy: Approved logo and original parcel artwork are preserved. Photographic illustrations are generated from those brand references and a consistent courier/doorstep reference. They depict an illustrative route, not recorded HiParcelo operations. Production image prompts and source provenance are in docs/journey-photography-prompts.json.

materials.shading: Metallic/roughness shading, Fresnel reflections, directional lighting, filtered shadows, contact shading and tone mapping
materials.foliage: Two-sided individual leaf geometry with matching clipped shadows
materials.water: Scroll-driven irregular wave normals, reflected sky, sun glints and shoreline foam

motion_preserved.scope: Original 3D motion model is unchanged. Photographic mode reuses its nine chapter boundaries, captions and stage timing; it has separate image camera movements.

geometry_scope: Geometry descriptions below apply to the optional original 3D journey.

photography.medium: AI-generated photographic illustrations; still images with animated camera movement and transitions, not filmed object or human motion
photography.loading: Current scene and immediate neighbors, bounded decoded cache; no autoplay or continuous frame loop
